review_scope: Inspect the merged tree at target_merged_commit, not merely the former PR head.
Verify authoritative v0.2 spec, WBS, ADR and source hierarchy.
Verify legacy prototype branch provenance and explicit separation of swap-match-3 rules from v0.2 connected-group Tap/Pop.
Verify branch inventory, source/license/IP risk records and build applicability.
Verify the handoff baseline has no Android app and that Android build gates are correctly NOT_APPLICABLE rather than PASS.
Verify the discrepancy between 19 blocking ADRs and the simulated QA report's 18 is recorded accurately.
Verify pinned Maestro v0.3.0, bootstrap, contract tests and GateRunner evidence.

Verify E00 artifact's baseline_sha, runner identity, ran_on_sha and log hash; reconcile that the artifact checks PR head 3555... while the reviewed target is merge commit 513... with that PR head as second parent.
Verify no simulated persona review is represented as human playtest evidence.
Identify missing or stale source references, WBS/task mismatches and any unsupported claims.

required_output.evidence: Exact merged SHA, E00 artifact/run, reviewer identity and coverage.
required_output.acceptance: No PASS if the merged tree diverges from evidence or any source/provenance claim is unsupported.

independence_requirement: Reviewer must be distinct from the EFB-000 builder/orchestrator and record an explicit identity.
